english: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty}\left((4|x|)^{n}+|x-5|^{n}\right)^{1/n}$. Then the greatest value of the function $g:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, $g(x)=\dfrac{1}{f(x)}$, is ______.
hindi: माना कि $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, $f(x)=\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty}\left((4|x|)^{n}+|x-5|^{n}\right)^{1/n}$ द्वारा परिभाषित है। तब फलन $g:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, $g(x)=\dfrac{1}{f(x)}$ का अधिकतम मान ______ है।
solution: $\Rightarrow f(x)=\max\{4|x|,\,|x-5|\}$, defined for all $x$ and $f(x)>0$ (both terms vanish together nowhere)
Least value of the maximum: where the two graphs cross, $4|x|=|x-5|$: $x=1$ (value $4$) or $x=-\dfrac53$ (value $\dfrac{20}{3}$)
For $x\le0$, $f(x)\ge|x-5|\ge5$; for $x\ge0$, $f$ is least where the increasing $4x$ meets the decreasing $5-x$, at $x=1$
Range of $f=[4,\infty)\Rightarrow$ range of $g=\left(0,\dfrac14\right]$; greatest value $0.25$
solution_full: Let $p,q\ge0$, not both zero, and $M=\max\{p,q\}>0$. Then $M^{n}\le p^{n}+q^{n}\le2M^{n}$, so $M\le(p^{n}+q^{n})^{1/n}\le2^{1/n}M$. Since $2^{1/n}\to1$, the limit is $M$.
With $p=4|x|$ and $q=|x-5|$ (never both zero, since $x=0$ gives $q=5$), $f(x)=\max\{4|x|,\,|x-5|\}$ for every real $x$, and $f(x)>0$. So $g=\dfrac1f$ is defined on $\mathbb{R}$.

For $0\le x\le5$: $4|x|=4x$ is increasing and $|x-5|=5-x$ is decreasing; they are equal at $4x=5-x$, $x=1$. For $x<1$, $f(x)=5-x>4$; for $x\ge1$, $f(x)\ge4x\ge4$. So the least value on this interval is $f(1)=4$.
Hence the least value of $f$ is $4$, attained at $x=1$, and $f$ is continuous and unbounded, so its range is $[4,\infty)$.
Then $g$ takes exactly the values in $\left(0,\dfrac14\right]$, and its greatest value is $\dfrac14=0.25$.
originality_note: New: a function defined by the limit (p^n + q^n)^{1/n}, which turns into the maximum of a stretched modulus and a shifted modulus; its range, then the reciprocal (way 2, function defined by a limit). Closest known: lim (a^n + b^n)^{1/n} = max(a, b) for constants. Different because: here p and q depend on x, so the limit defines a max-function whose range must be found.

concept_use.Domain and range of functions involving: f = max{4|x|, |x - 5|} is defined and positive on R; its range [4, infinity) comes from the crossing at x = 1, giving the range (0, 1/4] of g.
concept_use.Evaluation of limit involving max min op: The limit (p^n + q^n)^{1/n} = max{p, q} is evaluated by the squeeze M <= (p^n + q^n)^{1/n} <= 2^{1/n} M.
